title: SLICE LOOP in the track menu
author: MrScruff (rytm-mods); elemod port: Iced-Cream
description: Adds SLICE LOOP after SAVE TRACK in the track menu (FUNC + CHRO). On an empty sound track of 16 steps or more it places trigs on steps 1..16, locks trig n's sample START to 6(n-1) and END to 6n, and sets the track's TRIG defaults to SYN off, SMP on. Refuses, changing nothing, on the FX track, a shorter track or a track with any trig. Port of rytm-mods 0012-slice-loop.
